newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's Concha to explain policies in TV address.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's Concha to explain policies in TV address.

text.p: Ecuadorean Finance Minister Pablo Concha will address the nation Thursday night to explain tough new economic policies, officials said.
Concha, scheduled to speak at 2030 local time and EST/0130 GMT, will discuss the country's economic and fiscal situation and the effects of the new measures.
The speech comes amid nationwide protests against the economic plan of President Abdala Bucaram.
